extracted.intended_audience: readers and people who spot misinformation (general public)
extracted.subtask_description: Brief website 'About' guidance describing what Lead Stories does (fact‑checking) and inviting readers to report viral false, misleading, deceptive, or inaccurate stories, videos, or images. It also highlights site credibility markers and article labeling used on the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scope — items sought
rubrics_metrics.description: Lead Stories is a fact checking website that is always looking for the latest false, misleading, deceptive or inaccurate stories, videos or images going viral on the internet.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site focuses on viral content across formats (stories, videos, images) that are false, misleading, deceptive, or inaccurate; this defines what they will investigate and publish fact checks about.

rubrics_metrics.name: Audience submissions / tip reporting
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Readers are invited to report suspected misinformation to the site. If users can't find a specific page, they are directed to search or contact the site — indicating the site accepts and acts on crowdsourced reports or tips.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verification and affiliations
rubrics_metrics.description: Lead Stories is a: Verified signatory of the IFCN Code of Principles; Verified EFCSN member
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site signals adherence to external fact‑checking standards and networks (IFCN, EFCSN). This functions as a credibility/quality marker implying commitments such as transparency, nonpartisanship, sourcing, and corrections (though the IFCN principles themselves are not enumerated on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Article classification / labelling taxonomy
rubrics_metrics.description: Examples of labels used in article listings on the site include: 'Fact Check', 'AI Generated', 'Never Posted', 'Satire', 'Real Photo', 'AI Video'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lead Stories applies categorical labels to items to indicate the nature or verdict of a claim (e.g., whether content is AI‑generated, satire, a real photo, or a false claim). These labels help readers immediately understand the finding or content type.

rubrics_metrics.name: Searchability / preferred source guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Get more fact-checks in your Google Search results by setting up leadstories.com as one of your preferred sources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The site advises readers on how to increase visibility of its fact checks in search results by configuring leadstories as a preferred source in Google — presented as a practical tip rather than an editorial standard.
